entries.zh: 扇子（据汉字/对音推定，释义存疑）
entries.en: fan (presumed from the character and phonetic columns; uncertain)
entries.notes: 西语词头 Compañones 与汉字「膳子」及对音两栏无法互证；「膳子」疑为「扇子」形近之讹（亦不排除「仙水」一类词），语义无法定夺，故降置信。
汉字栏与闽南语栏均[残]，官话栏「cǔ. chiǎluck」难以确解，西语「Comparativo - mag.」缩略不明，材料不足。

entries.en: to compare, assess; comparison; to weigh merits

entries.zh: 譬论：设譬议论；用比喻说明
entries.en: to explain or discourse by analogy; illustrative comparison

entries.zh: 评品人物：品评人物、评量人之高下
entries.en: to appraise and compare people; to judge persons' worth

entries.zh: 像：像、如同（像这个或那个一样）
亲像：就像、正如（跟这个或那个一样）
entries.en: just like, the same as (this or that)

entries.zh: 评论：评议、议论；评论比较
entries.en: to comment and discuss critically; commentary, discussion

entries.zh: 譬论（同上条）：设譬议论；用比喻说明
entries.en: ut supra (as above): to explain by analogy; illustrative comparison
entries.notes: 「U.S.」按辞书惯例读作 ut supra（同上），与第5条「譬论」完全互证；缩写展开系推断，故降置信。

entries.zh: 譬喻：比喻、打比方；譬喻（讲道中所用的比喻）
赴选：前往应选、候职，比较何人更贤堪任
entries.en: to go and present oneself for selection (of appointment); to compare who deserves more

entries.zh: 规矩：圆规与矩尺（画圆测方之器）；测量；亦指规矩、法度
entries.en: compass and carpenter's square (measuring instruments); to measure; rules, standards

entries.zh: 乡里：同乡；同一乡里之人
entries.en: fellow-townsmen, compatriots from the same place; one's native village

entries.zh: 点拍位：乐曲节拍（板眼）之位；音乐拍子
entries.en: the beat (bar, measure) in music; the position where beats fall
to compete, contend in a match; to wager, bet
complacency, self-satisfaction; to be pleased with oneself

entries.notes: 汉字/对音作「令」，与西语 componer（组成、整理、修补）难以明确互证，或系词条错置；姑据汉字栏释义并降置信。

entries.zh: 捻：捻搓、捻合（以指捻转搓合成一体）
entries.en: to twist or twirl between the fingers; to twist together into one
entries.notes: 西语 componer 与「捻」对应较松（或取「捻合为一体」之义），官话栏又给出两种读法，故降置信。
